preserve_existing.instruction: Reuse valid saved bundles without calling extraction during this pause. Review D022/124 temporal gaps first; do not replace valid empty D011.

proposed_budget_not_authorized.explanation: One extraction + one verification + at most one repair. Existing provider permits three transport attempts per logical response.
proposed_budget_not_authorized.cost_formula: At confirmed per-million rates I and O, expected cost ≈ (12000..35000)*I/1e6 + (10000..40000)*O/1e6; conservative allowance 0.36*I + 0.288*O. Rates and dollar cap must be agreed before execution.
proposed_budget_not_authorized.cost_estimate_status: No current rates or dollar cap verified/approved; token estimates are planning assumptions, not a billing guarantee.
proposed_budget_not_authorized.enforcement_gap: Current pipeline bounds responses/retries but has no cumulative dollar/token cutoff. Before resuming, agree account spend cap and timeout policy; do not blindly retry an unknown-billed timeout.
stop_conditions: first document complete or validation failure
three logical responses or returned review ceiling reached
proposed_budget_not_authorized.authorization_needed: Explicit user resume plus model/rate/dollar-budget approval; no queue executed.
